TaskDescription: Survey assessing stressful events experienced during the specified reporting period.

date_time.Description: UTC date and time at which the record was created.

is_relevant.Description: Whether the row contains a task-relevant observation rather than instructions, a cue, or another non-scored event.

screen_size.Description: Screen dimensions reported by the web application in width-by-height pixels.

time_elapsed_ms.Description: Elapsed time from task start when the record was created.

ua.Description: Browser user-agent string recorded by the web application.

version.Description: Version of the study web application used to administer the task.

Q0.Description: Number of stressors reported, using the original task coding.

Q1.Description: Q1 value recorded by the task application.

Q2.Description: Q2 value recorded by the task application.

Q3.Description: Q3 value recorded by the task application.

Q4.Description: Q4 value recorded by the task application.

Q5.Description: Q5 value recorded by the task application.

Q6.Description: Q6 value recorded by the task application.

Q7.Description: Q7 value recorded by the task application.
